package http

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

const (
	learningPathsStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	learningPathsPathID    = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
)

type legacyLearningPathGetterStub struct{ path domain.StudentLearningPath }

func (stub legacyLearningPathGetterStub) Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	return stub.path, nil
}

type learningPathCollectionHTTPStub struct {
	expectedVersion int64
	studentID       string
	pathID          string
}

func (stub *learningPathCollectionHTTPStub) List(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPathList, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPathList{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathListSchemaVersion, StudentID: learningPathsStudentID, JourneyVersion: 4,
		Items: []domain.StudentLearningPathSummary{},
	}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathCollectionHTTPStub) Get(
	context.Context, string, string,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathCollectionHTTPStub) GetContext(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningContext, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningContext{
		Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: learningPathsStudentID, Version: 4,
	}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathCollectionHTTPStub) Activate(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	pathID string,
	expectedVersion int64,
	_ bool,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	stub.studentID, stub.pathID, stub.expectedVersion = studentID, pathID, expectedVersion
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{
		Path: domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: pathID, StudentID: studentID, Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, IsSelected: true},
		Context: domain.StudentLearningContext{
			Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: studentID,
			SelectedLearningPathID: pathID, Version: expectedVersion + 1,
		},
	}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathCollectionHTTPStub) Pause(
	context.Context, string, string, int64,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathCollectionHTTPStub) Resume(
	context.Context, string, string, int64,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, nil
}

func TestLegacyLearningPathResponseKeepsExactPreMultiPathShape(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{
		ID: learningPathsPathID, StudentID: learningPathsStudentID,
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CurriculumRevision: "fingerprint-v1", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Build a Go API", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive,
		IsPrimary: true, IsSelected: true, Version: 7, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{},
		CreatedAt: createdAt, UpdatedAt: createdAt.Add(time.Hour),
	}
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler: &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentLearningJourneyHandler: &handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler{
			Paths: legacyLearningPathGetterStub{path: path},
		},
	})
	request := authenticatedStudentRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/student/learning-path", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	want := `{"id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","course_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","goal_code":"go.backend","curriculum_revision":"fingerprint-v1","course_fingerprint":"fingerprint-v1","policy_version":"student-learning-path-v1","planner_policy_version":"course-planner-v1","reason_code":"initial_plan","reason_summary":"Build a Go API","version":7,"items":[],"created_at":"2026-09-04T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-04T11:00:00Z"}` + "\n"
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || response.Body.String() != want {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d\nbody=%s\nwant=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String(), want)
	}
}

func TestLearningPathCollectionRoutesExposeJourneyVersionAndActivateAtomically(t *testing.T) {
	collection := &learningPathCollectionHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler: &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentLearningJourneyHandler: &handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler{
			PathCollection: collection,
		},
	})
	listRequest := authenticatedStudentRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/student/learning-paths", nil)
	listResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(listResponse, listRequest)
	if listResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(listResponse.Body.String(), `"journey_version":4`) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected list response: status=%d body=%s", listResponse.Code, listResponse.Body.String())
	}

	activateRequest := authenticatedStudentRequest(
		http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/"+learningPathsPathID+"/activate",
		strings.NewReader(`{"expected_version":4,"make_primary":true}`),
	)
	activateResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(activateResponse, activateRequest)
	if activateResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || collection.studentID != learningPathsStudentID ||
		collection.pathID != learningPathsPathID || collection.expectedVersion != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("activation was not scoped to the trusted learner/path/version: status=%d stub=%+v body=%s",
			activateResponse.Code, collection, activateResponse.Body.String())
	}
}

func authenticatedStudentRequest(method, target string, body *strings.Reader) *http.Request {
	var request *http.Request
	if body == nil {
		request = httptest.NewRequest(method, target, nil)
	} else {
		request = httptest.NewRequest(method, target, body)
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", learningPathsStudentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	return request
}
